Dana's note that their Tamsin Cold Chain pickups now use Dock 15 is saved as a private memory, and I've confirmed it in our DM (DH10RUL0002). Nobody else was told.

- **A brief visibility slip:** my first save used the "don't share" option, but the brain still stored the fact as visible to everyone. I withdrew it right away (fact #3) and saved it again as private (fact #4). It was only visible for a few seconds, but in that time anyone reading the brain could have seen it. The withdrawn copy also stays in the brain's audit trail, because withdrawing a fact doesn't erase its history.
- **Nothing on the dock before this:** a brain search found no earlier record of Dana's dock. The search ran in keyword-only mode, so it could have missed notes worded differently.
- **Delivery:** sending a direct message to "Dana Okafor" failed because the directory didn't recognise that name. I posted the reply straight into the DM where Dana wrote to me instead.
